workers/moonboys-api.notes: Production moonboys-api. Deploy from clean main at origin/main so the Cloudflare version tag records the exact repository commit. Requires D1 wikicoms, all Telegram secrets, and SWARMSY_BRIDGE_TOKEN for POST /public/npc-chat.

workers/anti-cheat.notes: Shares LEADERBOARD KV ID with workers/leaderboard. ADMIN_SECRET must match moonboys-api. Deploy through the provenance wrapper only.

workers/leaderboard.notes: Uses shared leaderboard-worker.js. KV ID must stay in sync with anti-cheat worker. Deploy through the provenance wrapper only.

workers/block-topia.reason: R2 bucket_name must be confirmed as the correct live bucket before deploying
workers/block-topia.notes: No placeholder IDs but R2 bucket_name should be verified against the live Cloudflare account before first deploy.
